avgDriverWaitMinutes.description: The wait. Mean of arrival to the first DoorWorkStarted; null when no trailer had door work.

p50DwellMinutes.description: Median dwell, the typical trailer (additive, ADR 0011).

p90DwellMinutes.description: 90th percentile of the dwell, the long tail an average hides (additive, ADR 0011).

avgProcessingMinutes.description: The processing. Mean of DoorWorkStarted to DoorWorkCompleted over the completed door work sessions of these trailers; null when none completed (additive, ADR 0011).
